subject: minor typo in gaussian process fit, sec 16.3 of stan user's manual

messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: minor typo in gaussian process fit, sec 16.3 of stan user's manual
parts:
Hi,

After trying neural network kernel I figured out that there is a minor typo in the code:
for (i in 1:(N-1)) {
for (j in i:N) {

should be replaced with:
for (i in 1:(N-1)) {
for (j in (i+1):N) {

Linas

it fixes a typo.
